generator_drift_detection.what: The asset is a projection of the three packages. Added `python3 tools/build-neh2-preview.py --check`, which regenerates in memory and fails if the committed asset differs byte-for-byte. Added root script `npm run verify:preview`. Added Jest drift tests: the generator file must exist and be the one named in the asset, and the asset's canonical_digest must equal the recomputed digest of content/nehemiah-2/canonical.v2.json.
generator_drift_detection.verified: Mutating the asset digest makes the drift test fail; restoring passes. `npm run verify:preview` reports up to date. Two consecutive generator runs are byte-identical.

overlapping_mentions.what: Selector lookup is now word-bounded everywhere (generator, projection tool, mobile renderer), so 'us' can no longer match inside 'Jerusalem'. Both generators now FAIL the build on any per-verse overlap. Removed three overlaps: 2:7 dropped the nested 'west of the Euphrates' (the governors collective keeps the phrase), 2:13 dropped the nested 'Jerusalem' (the wall phrase keeps it), and 2:17 re-anchored 'Jerusalem' to the standalone first occurrence (ordinal 2 -> 1) so it no longer nests in 'the wall of Jerusalem'.
overlapping_mentions.verified: Generator overlap check passes; 74 mentions; content-schema and mobile selector tests resolve every mention to its word-bounded occurrence; 2:8 still proves ordinal handling (second 'the king').

legacy_timeline_loading.what: TimelineRail no longer calls getTimeline() from neh2Draft when curated stops are provided; the legacy prototype timeline loads only for chapters that pass no stops. ReaderView passes curated stops for Nehemiah 2 (empty when the preview is invalid) so legacy data can never leak into the curated flow.
legacy_timeline_loading.verified: Curated rail tests assert only curated stops render; no neh2Draft timeline import is hit on the Nehemiah 2 path.

web_bundling.what: `expo start`/`expo export` failed on the web target with 'Unable to resolve module ./wa-sqlite/wa-sqlite.wasm from expo-sqlite/web/worker.ts' because Metro did not treat .wasm as an asset. Added apps/mobile/metro.config.js pushing 'wasm' into resolver.assetExts (the documented expo-sqlite web setup). Inert for iOS/Android.
web_bundling.verified: npx expo export --platform web now bundles the worker chunk and exports all 14 static routes; iOS and Android exports still succeed unchanged.
